name: Heather M. Young
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Tacoma, Washington
about: Heather M. Young is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2017 - 2026. She works at Tuell & Young, located in Tacoma, Washington, and provides legal services for issues involving Family Law and Alternative Dispute Resolution to the surrounding community.
Heather Young completed legal studies at Seattle University School of Law and graduated with the class of 1997. Heather Young passed the bar in 1997.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
